description: Defines procedures and data structures for selecting and calculating default PUCCH (Physical Uplink Control Channel) resources according to 3GPP TS38.213 specifications. Includes structures, function declarations for resource index, PRB index, cyclic shift, and default resource parameters.

classes.name: pucch_default_resource
classes.description: Structure holding parameters for default PUCCH resource as per TS38.213, including format, symbol index, symbol count, PRB offset, and cyclic shift indexes.

methods.name: get_pucch_default_resource_index
methods.description: Calculates the default PUCCH resource index based on CCE indices and delta indicator, following TS38.213 Section 9.2.1.

methods.name: get_pucch_default_prb_index
methods.description: Determines the PRB indexes for the first and second hops of the PUCCH resource before dedicated resources, based on resource index, PRB offset, number of cyclic shifts, and BWP size.

methods.name: get_pucch_default_cyclic_shift
methods.description: Calculates the cyclic shift for a given PUCCH resource index and number of cyclic shifts, following TS38.213 Section 9.2.1.

methods.name: get_pucch_default_resource
methods.description: Retrieves default PUCCH resource parameters based on a row index and BWP size, as specified in TS38.213 Table 9.2.1-1.
